summary: Mixed Martial Arts Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 16, 2026, announcing termination of its $20 million equity line of credit with American Ventures LLC, with confirmation that no drawdowns ever occurred. The registrant also confirmed no funds were drawn under a separate $5 million unsecured revolving loan facility. This is a voluntary capital-structure simplification, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic review are involved.
